notes.title: Small Update 1: Audio Sliders
notes.content:
1.) Added audio sliders to let you boost the volume of music and SFX by another 40%.
2.) Fixed an English typo in Chapter 7: "go ourside the circle." -> "go outside the circle."
3.) Fixed a rare stuck bug in the marble game (Chapter 7).
4.) Applied fix to prevent a rare issue where the staircase door in Chapter 8 can knock up the player.

notes.title: Quick Fix 2: Typo Fix
notes.content:
1. Fixed 3 English typo found in Chapter 8 and Chapter 9.
 - "No not yet..." -> "No, not yet..."
 - "Hehe, not not really." -> "Hehe, no, not really."
 - "Oh course everyone treats her different." -> "Of course everyone treats her different."

notes.title: Quick Fix 1: Typo Fix
notes.content: - Fixed a typo in the first conversation of Chapter 5. From 'but they they will' to 'but then they will'.
